prose.title: React/DOM Properties
prose.text:
At its core, the Markdown component is a regular <div> element. Thus, both DOM and React properties, methods, and events are accessible. To read up on all of the possible DOM attributes and types available for div elements, check out this [MDN Web Documents page.](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/div) To learn more about DOM events and methods, you can read more on the [MDN Web Events documentation page](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Events).

Also, feel free to read about the [types of React events available](https://reactjs.org/docs/handling-events.html), or see [how DOM attributes change in React.](https://reactjs.org/docs/dom-elements.html) Working in tandem with Styled Components, you also have access to the [as property.](https://styled-components.com/docs/api#as-polymorphic-prop)

tables.name: Props
rows: Custom components and props to override html elements such as 'img' or 'pre'. By default 'a', 'p', 'img', and table elements are overridden with grommet components.

{
  a: { component: Anchor, props: {...} },
  img: { component: Image },
  p: { component: Paragraph },
  table: { component: Table },
  td: { component: TableCell },
  tbody: { component: TableBody },
  tfoot: { component: TableFooter },
  th: { component: TableCell },
  thead: { component: TableHeader },
  tr: { component: TableRow }
}
Used to tune the jsx compiler to specific properties, available options on [markdown-to-jsx](https://github.com/probablyup/markdown-to-jsx).
